text:
maria: Quick pulse — need a tight benchmark narrative for launch: 2 hero visuals (cost curve + stability heatmap), a 6s social clip, and a 1‑pager. Keep claims footnoted.

ajay: For visuals: cost curve = $/1M tokens vs QPS (baseline / quantized / cached+batch). heatmap = P95 across seq_len x QPS, highlight safe zones.

sam: Social clip idea: animate a slider across the cost curve showing tradeoffs; 6s, muted, caption: 'Pick your tradeoff'.

jen: Messaging tests: A) 'Up to 55% lower token cost' B) 'Predictable P95 at burst traffic' C) combo. CTA: 'Run this benchmark on your workload'.

eli: I'll draft the 1‑pager + slides. Need a compact CSV with model, seq_len, tokens/sec, $/1M, p50/p95/p99. @ajay, can you post numbers?

ajay: Pasted sample rows to #bench-results and uploaded CSV: rw-opt-8b,64,62000,9.1,12,36,120; rw-opt-8b-q4_0,64,79000,6.8,14,40,140; rw-opt-8b-cached,64,98000,4.9,13,38,125. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-174999

noah: Inbound routing: leads that run the benchmark and select >100k monthly tokens -> AE/Solutions. Add hidden form field expected_monthly_tokens.

ajay: Tiny docs snippet for perf probe: ```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/ping \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8b","seq_len":64}'
```

maria: Design rules: fixed axis ranges, colorblind palette, annotate where cache/batching kick in (200-800 QPS). Add small table with % delta vs baseline.

eli: I'll post draft one‑pager tomorrow AM.

maria: OK — assignees: ajay = final CSV + charts (Wed AM), eli = 1‑pager + slides (Wed EOD), jen = social + landing (Thu AM), sam = webinar ops (Thu EOD), noah = SDR routing. Keep it lean. :rocket:
